features: Fix live prices that remained frozen because the WebSocket relay delivered upstream frames as Blob/binary data and the browser monitor could not parse them reliably.
Primary live feed is now Pionex market/tickers through the Cloudflare Worker every 10 seconds, exactly matching the requested monitor cadence.
Worker caches each PERP/SPOT ticker snapshot for 8 seconds, so multiple browsers share the same upstream snapshot instead of multiplying Pionex API traffic.
Only changed table cells are patched; there is still no page reload or table flash.
Every 10-second snapshot updates the current live daily candle and immediately recalculates S-State, midline slope, average-K and CCI-SMA.
The WebSocket relay is retained as a secondary/debug path and now converts Blob/ArrayBuffer frames to text before heartbeat parsing/forwarding.
Includes v0.3.04 R2 watchlist/kline cache and cross-device synchronization.
